info.name: Fonoa E-Invoicing Lookup V2 Transactions API

description.content: Unified e-invoicing API that manages the full transaction lifecycle including submitting, adjusting, crediting, and canceling e-invoices in compliance with local mandates across multiple countries. Supports backfilling previously reported transactions and retrieving transaction history and status.
